acceptanceCriteria: The ledger loop hold names the progressSignal under a versioned dispatch-state profile, with old ledgers still readable.
Spec requirement recorded with acceptance evidence.
body: Residual from V1-1608 (PR #1085, ATR-V0-083 non-goal note). Expected: the dispatcher ledger's loop hold records the progressSignal that governed it. Actual: only event details and messages name it, because the ledger is strict taskman-dispatch-state/6.
title: dispatch ledger loop hold should name the progressSignal
